periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Ran a winter food drive at City Hall and library branches as the holiday surplus ran down, collecting 18,400 pounds across all sources. Agreed a quarterly drive calendar with the food bank. Partners: Harbor Area Food Bank, United Way of the Harbor Region.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Run a spring drive at schools and libraries and recruit seaport employers for a summer drive.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Ran the spring drive at schools and library branches, lifting donations to 24,100 pounds. Signed up seaport employers for a summer employee drive. Partners: Harbor Area Food Bank, United Way of the Harbor Region, Seaport Workers Clinic.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Run the seaport employee drive and a grocery-store round-up campaign.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Ran the seaport employee drive and a grocery-store round-up campaign over the summer. Harbor Area Food Bank reports its warehouse is better stocked than at this point last year. Partners: Harbor Area Food Bank, United Way of the Harbor Region, local employers.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Launch the holiday drive in October with a target set jointly with the food bank, and add a donation option to the Parks/Rec/Libraries registration page.
